Sorry for the extended absence, we all have our lives to live. Although I was not very impressed by Part 1, Part 2 made this one of TY's most beautiful stories, and one of their hardest to translate. Now that the tankoubon is out, they may be taking a break, or focusing entirely on Kairakuten (Those works have official translations). The tankoubon translation will be out very soon, maybe even tomorrow.

I've made the threat many times, but I would like to translate other artists from the past going forward. The stories may not be as artistic as TY, but sometimes there's fun to be had in brain-dead smut that is nothing more than what it is and can be more cartoony and erotic. Those who have emailed to ask me to translate Lolita Complex, that is a request in the backburner, there's other lolis and JKs from other artists that are in dire need of translation and I'm already slow as it is. Lolita Complex is also officially translated, even if badly.
